message.content: It started about two weeks after I had a cold or respiratory infection. After that, I got more and more short of breath, even with light activity like walking a short distance or climbing stairs. My legs started swelling and I've had belly pain too. It's been getting gradually worse. I haven't had any chest pain or dizziness, at least at the beginning. Other than that, I don't remember anything else I can tell you about, like fevers, urine changes or bowel changes. It wasn't mentioned to me, so I'm not sure.
